_doc: KNOWN-GAPS ALLOWLIST for the unique reconciliation guardrail.
Why this exists: scripts/graph/uniques.js enumerates unique nodes from
pob-uniques/*.json, while RePoE's uniques.json is only a name-keyed metadata
join. So Path of Building — not RePoE — decides which uniques exist on the site,
and any unique RePoE knows about but PoB has no text block for was dropped with
NO warning. That is how Loreweave went missing for a whole league without the
The guardrail (applyOverlays in scripts/graph/manual.js) now diffs RePoE's unique
names against the built graph every build:
- a missing unique NOT listed here      -> loud warning (new hole, investigate)
- a name listed here that now HAS a node -> retirement warning (delete the entry)
Listing a name here is an explicit, reviewed decision to accept the hole — per the
'Decide first: curate, or accept the hole' policy in CLAUDE.md. It is NOT a way to
silence the guardrail: every entry needs a `why` stating what was checked.
SEARCH GOTCHA when triaging a new entry: internal names differ from display names.
Flesh Crucible's mods are UniqueVivisectionPrice* — searching mods.json for 'Flesh
Crucible' finds nothing and makes it look like a data hole when it is not. Derive a
stem from the item's art path and visual_identity.id and search for THAT too before
